help: Norwegian unit-linked endowment insurance with a small insurance component. Withdrawals realize a proportional share of capital and any gain or loss. Use the premiums still invested for the tax basis.
field.pastEquity: Shielding already applied to equity gains this year
field.pastInterest: Shielding already applied to interest gains this year
help.equity: Enter the effective average equity share for withdrawals from your insurer's tax statement, including the annual threshold rule already applied by the insurer.
help.shielding: Use the verified unused shielding available at the start of the plan. The forecast does not accrue new shielding.
help.history: Complete only if you enter gross gains from earlier withdrawals in the current tax year. Use the deduction already applied to that part of those gains.
invalid.equity: Enter the effective equity percentage from the insurer's tax statement (0–100%).
invalid.shielding: Enter a non-negative unused verified shielding amount in NOK.
